definitions.explanation: Consisting of many different kinds of things mixed together without particular order.

examples.japanese: {雑多|ざった}な{品物|しなもの}が{並|なら}ぶ。
{雑多|ざった}な{情報|じょうほう}が{飛|と}び{交|か}う。
examples.english: Various kinds of information are flying around.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}には{雑多|ざった}な{商品|しょうひん}が{所狭|ところせま}しと{置|お}かれている。
examples.english: This shop is crammed with a diverse assortment of goods.

notes:
{雑多|ざった} describes a state of being mixed with various different things. It can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

RELATED WORDS:
- {雑然|ざつぜん}: cluttered, disorderly (more negative, emphasizes disorder)
- {多様|たよう}: diverse (more positive, emphasizes variety)
- {様々|さまざま}: various (neutral)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑多|ざった}な{品物|しなもの}: miscellaneous goods
- {雑多|ざった}な{情報|じょうほう}: various kinds of information
- {雑多|ざった}な{人々|ひとびと}: diverse people
